summary: Nintendo's ink-based third-person shooter series, covering the Wii U original, Switch sequels and DLC, and the announced Switch 2 single-player spinoff.

entries.title: Splatoon

emulation.notes: Use Wii U hardware for the official route; emulation/private network preservation is outside the official recommendation.

primary.why: The first Splatoon is a Wii U-exclusive release, so original Wii U hardware is the only official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Splatoon on Wii U hardware; note that official Wii U online services have ended, affecting the original multiplayer experience.

all_releases.reason: primary: only platform for the first Splatoon.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-platform release, but online-service preservation is the major caveat.

entries.remaster_caveats: Official Wii U online services ended, so the live multiplayer layer is not normally available through Nintendo's original service.

entries.title: Splatoon 2

primary.why: Splatoon 2 is a Switch-exclusive sequel, and Octo Expansion adds a major 80-mission single-player campaign and playable Octoling unlock route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Splatoon 2 on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with Octo Expansion installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch release with Octo Expansion DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete route with DLC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch plus Octo Expansion is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC ownership is required for Octo Expansion content.

entries.title: Splatoon 3
entries.definitive_edition: Splatoon 3 plus Expansion Pass / Side Order

primary.version: Switch release plus Expansion Pass / Side Order
primary.why: Splatoon 3 is a Switch-exclusive sequel, and the Expansion Pass adds Inkopolis plus the Side Order single-player campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Play Splatoon 3 on Nintendo Switch or Switch 2 backward compatibility with the Expansion Pass installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch release with Expansion Pass / Side Order DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete route with DLC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch plus Expansion Pass is the complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC ownership is required for Side Order content.

primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route until the Switch 2 release is available and final content/build details are verified.
